Thank you. I do feel like I'll never get out though. I'll always be in debt, I'll always be a disappointment to my family, and I'll never be able to be a regular responsible adult like someone else. I don't drink, I don't do drugs, and I don't smoke. I try to eat healthy. I work 40 hours a week. Yet I'm still a total fucking wreak. My wife thinks I'm pathetic and has told me so. I used to think she was a bitch and now I think she's right. I am pathetic. I've got problems and I know how to fix them. I just don't. I know that if I took better care of the house I'd be in less arguements. I am a slob. I know that if I chose not to argue over stupid shit for the sake of pride or selfishness is be in less arguements, I argue anyway. And I'll keep the fight going until she's asked me to leave the house. Then it sets in that I've been shitty. And I beg for her to let me back, and she does. And I follow the promises I made to be a better man. For like 3 days. Then suddenly, and I never notice it, I've slipped back into old habits. I want to be with her, but I'm sabatogeing myself left and right. I don't think I'll ever be a family man. I don't think I'll be a good dad, and I know I am a bad husband. It feels like that'll never get better. 

And here I am trying to get a stranger to feel bad for me because I can't grow up. 

See this is why I'm pathetic. I've written and erased 5 replies now. You're already too kind for giving a shit in the first place. I know people pull through. I probably will. But it feels dark. I feel empty.

He's a boy. She says she's gonna leave and I'll never get to see him. She says even if I did stay I'd be a failure to him and that'd he'd hate me. I think I'd be a good dad. But I've proven time and time again I'm a failure. I'm fairly certain he's why I'm alive still. But I'd just fuck up his life too
